subject: No Draw Icon Visible for Random Forest

messages.author: f761e28237af0201
messages.subject: No Draw Icon Visible for Random Forest
parts:
Hello All,

I was very excited to find Rattle which makes running analysis in R so much easier.

I am running Rattle Version 3.4.1 with R version 3.1.2 in Windows 7.

I am able to load my data and make and view boxplots, but I cannot find the draw icon so I do not know what the decision trees look like.

I will install Rattle in Ubuntu later today to see if the Icon is visible in Linux but I wanted to ask the group if someone knew what the problem was.

I am also wondering if an older version of Rattle will solve this problem.

Thank You,

Adam Oliphant

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: No Draw Icon Visible for Random Forest
parts:
You can draw decision trees from rpart and party but I'm not aware of an easy way to draw the individual trees from the random forest - probably needs some code to convert the randomForest data structure into a tree data structure. A future version of Rattle might solve this issue - but it needs some coding.

Graham Williams
http://togaware.com
